constraints.evidence_quote: Under normal market conditions, the Fund intends to repurchase 5% of its outstanding shares at NAV on a quarterly basis.
constraints.interpretation: Each quarterly offer is for this % of outstanding shares; tenders above it are prorated. Rule 23c-3 allows 5-25%, and the fund may (but need not) take up to 2% more when oversubscribed.

constraints.description: Repurchase offers only in the listed months
constraints.evidence_quote: Quarterly repurchases occur in the months of March, June, September and December.
constraints.interpretation: Interval-fund liquidity is only available in these offer months; the simulator uses exactly the months named here.

constraints.evidence_quote: If the Fund determines not to repurchase more than the Repurchase Offer Amount or if Shareholders tender shares in an amount exceeding the Repurchase Offer Amount plus 2.00% of the outstanding Shares on the Repurchase Request Deadline, the Fund will repurchase the Shares on a pro rata basis.
constraints.interpretation: Fill % depends on aggregate tenders, treated as a scenario assumption.

constraints.description: Early repurchase fee on shares held under one year
constraints.evidence_quote: A 2.00% early repurchase fee will be charged by the Fund with respect to any repurchase of Shares from a Shareholder at any time prior to the day immediately preceding the one-year anniversary of the Shareholder's purchase of the Shares.
constraints.interpretation: Deducted from proceeds only for shares repurchased within about a year of purchase. Whether the household's shares are past that point is a scenario input.

constraints.evidence_quote: The Fund will distribute payment to Shareholders no later than seven calendar days after the Repurchase Pricing Date.
constraints.interpretation: Pricing up to 14 days after the request deadline plus up to 7 days to pay: modelled as a one-month lag.
